'''Sephjet Josall''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Discovered to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] during infancy, Sephjet Josall was taken to the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] for [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Eventually [[Initiate Trials/Legends|graduating]] from the [[Jedi academy|Temple's academy]], Josall was selected to be a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] by a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. After years of study, and having constructed a blue-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], Josall went on to pass his [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials of Knighthood]] and was given the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]].

[[File:JosallLightsaber.png|thumb|left|200px|Josall's secondary lightsaber]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Jedi Josall was stationed at the Temple when [[Master of the Order/Legends|Master of the Order]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] rallied all available Jedi to join a [[Jedi assault team/Legends|strike team]] to free the captured Jedi [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], as well as [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] from execution by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Arriving on the dusty plains of the foundry world, Jedi Josall aided in storming the [[Petranaki arena]] with about 200 comrades in order to free the prisoners. Armed with an extra lightsaber, Josall was assigned to pass it to one of the captured Jedi with the help of [[Nicanas Tassu/Legends|Nicanas Tassu]]. Rushing the arena floor, Josall and Tassu were able to pass on their spare weapons swiftly.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Sephjet-Josall-Hasbro.jpg|thumb|right|125px|Sephjet Josall in action figure form.]]
Sephjet Josall is played by [[Joseph Jett Sally]], a film editor of the [[Prequel trilogy]]. An action figure of Josall was released by ''[[Hasbro]]'' in [[2013]], along with the likes of fellow Jedi [[Sarrissa Jeng/Legends|Sarrissa Jeng]], [[Roan Shryne]], [[Khaat Qiyn/Legends|Khaat Qyin]], [[Que-Mars Redath-Gom/Legends|Que-Mars Redath-Gom]], and [[Selig Kenjenn]].

Although his [[Death/Legends|death]] in the Battle of Geonosis was not officially confirmed, Holocron Keeper [[Leland Chee]] listed him among Jedi who fought in the Battle who fates were unknown but likely dead in a [[2005]] [[Star Wars: Blogs]] post.<ref name="Chee">{{Blog|holocron|10|Jedi Casualties: Battle of Geonosis}}</ref>
